verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair axis for a team chat product, but the evidence shows no first-party AI assistant inside Zulip. What it documents is an interactive bot framework and Botserver that let developers write and run their own bots. Those are developer building blocks, not a built-in assistant users can delegate tasks to, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Zulip’s API has a powerful framework for interactive bots that react to messages in Zulip. You can write and run a custom bot, or run an existing Zulip bot.
